recentItems.title: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania FM/HD Bandscan #2 - September 14, 2026
recentItems.description:
From Center City. (My apologies about the loud noises/sirens - after all, it was done outside, and didn't have many options to filter that out. When I return home, I'll do some editing to splice it out.)

In addition to these three scans, I also did a couple through my recorder. However, those will be uploaded when I return home.

I also attempted to do the corridor between Philly and New York, but it's mostly static - sitting under active electric lines don't help with that. However, I will upload those scans anyway, since I did capture a few stations, and to show what the dial sounds like when transitioning between markets.

recentItems.title: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania FM/HD Bandscan #1 - September 14, 2026
recentItems.description:
Welcome to the City of Brotherly Love!

Spent only a day in Philly, but was able to get a few things while here. I primarily focused on HD-only subchannel IDs this go around due to time, and those will be uploaded when I come home. For now, enjoy the bandscans.

Taken in Center City.
